text:
sara: Customer (org_acme_42) raised a billing discrepancy — they were charged twice for what looks like the same streaming completion after a connection drop. Ticket: https://support.example/acme/9876. Invoice snippet says client_request_id=cid-77 appears twice. Can someone triage?

 tim: on it. can you paste the raw request headers or sample curl?

 sara: pasted sample from the customer:
 ```
 curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams \\n   -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_cust_X\" \\n   -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\n   -d '{"model":"gpt-large","prompt":"...long prompt..."}'
 ```
 They did NOT set Idempotency-Key or x-client-request-id.

 roshan: I queried the metering ledger for org_acme_42 around that time. Found two meter events: meter_event_987 and meter_event_988. Both reference the same customer-side client_request_id (cid-77) in metadata but have different internal request_id (req_abc123 / req_def456). Timestamps 1814999987 and 1815000012. Looks like gateway retried and backend created a new run. :eyes:

 tim: gateway logs show upstream returned a 504 on stream init, gateway retried request after 8s. We currently only dedupe when Idempotency-Key is present. If customer didn't send one, gateway issues a retry which hits model backend as a distinct invocation. sample log excerpt: 
 ```
 [1814999987] ingress: incoming req req_abc123 client_req=cid-77 idempotency_key=
 [1814999995] upstream: connection error -> 504
 [1815000003] ingress: retrying req -> created req_def456 
 ```

 maggie: yep that pattern will double-meter. Billing counts a token usage per completed model run; two completions => double billing. We should either require a client id header or gate automatic retries when no idempotency header exists. :+1:

 ingress-bot: existing policy: retry-on-5xx/504 up to 2 times, dedupe only when header x-idempotency-key present.

 tim: proposed short-term mitigation: modify retry policy to not retry idempotently for streaming/init endpoints if x-client-request-id or Idempotency-Key is missing. Patch suggestion (gateway conf):
 ```yaml
 retries:
   enabled: true
   idempotent_only: true   # only auto-retry when idempotency header present
   endpoints_no_retry: ["/v1/streams/init"]
 ```

 maggie: that sounds safe. canary to 10% traffic for 1 hour, monitor error/success + billing spike alerts.

 roshan: billing ops — if we confirm these two meter events are duplicates, we'll issue a one-off credit for org_acme_42 and mark the ledger entries as reconciled. tagging billing ticket BT-4321.

 sara: repro steps the customer provided (we reproduced locally):
 1) start streaming request without x-client-request-id or Idempotency-Key
 2) forcibly drop TCP (simulate network blip) right after prompt sent
 3) gateway sees timeout and retries the request -> backend runs twice
 
 curl repro snippet: 
 ```bash
 # start stream (no idempotency header)
 curl -N https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_cust_X" -d '{"model":"gpt-large","prompt":"repeat me 10000 tokens"}'
 # during upload: kill -9 <curl_pid> to simulate drop, then wait for gateway retry
 ```

 tim: thanks. I'll open a PR for the gateway change and include a migration plan. We should also add an observability signal: detect multiple meter events with same client_request_id within 120s and emit alert.

 roshan: noted. I'll queue the billing adjustment and keep the customer updated.

 sara: customer update sent (they asked for root cause + ETA). Will follow up once PR is merged. :relieved:

 maggie: quick follow-up long-term: encourage clients to send x-client-request-id or Idempotency-Key in SDKs and enforce via SDK docs + runtime validation. Add a warning in console if project has a high rate of retries without idempotency. :thinking:

 tim: ack. creating ENG task and adding to eng-infra backlog.

 sara: thanks everyone. marking thread for escalation -> SRE/infra to own the patch/rollout. :white_check_mark:
